before: Closing punctuation followed by an opening parenthesis retained its full advance unless character compression shortened it.
after: The two supported SimSun pairs can use authored positive kerning thresholds independently of character compression. Direct noPunctuationKerning settings disable this subset. Derived spacing retains original text, offsets, and authored formatting.
reason: The change affects derived layout geometry only. Canonical document nodes, collaboration operations, shared formats, and font execution limits stay unchanged.
